fiducial: pT_l > 20 GeV, |eta_l| < 2.5, pT_nu > 25 GeV, m_T > 40 GeV, Born-level leptons (ATLAS 7 TeV)

provenance.nnlojet: NNLOJET v1.0.2 with the patch in nnlojet_patch/
provenance.runcard: runcards/w_moments_WM.run (its physics blocks verbatim; PDF = CT18NNLO[k]; central scale only)
provenance.vegas_grids: member 0's warm-up for every member, with common seeds: every member integrates the same phase-space points, so the member differences are strongly correlated

conventions.moments: values[k] = <T_n> of member k, every channel and both seeds summed (ratio of sums); the runs are short and meant for differences: load_moments(..., pdf_member=k) adds values[k] - values[0] to the main table's moments, and window_rate[k] - window_rate[0] to its window rate
conventions.sigma_fid_ratio: sigma_fid of member k over member 0 (norm_born)
conventions.band: released.hessian_band(x) on the 59 re-solves: the asymmetric Hessian band, divided by 1.645 (68% CL) by default

validation: member 0 against the main table: worst pull 1.5 (m_w), 1.9 (y_abs), 2.2 (ctw_full), 1.5 (pt_w)
